TRUSTED: ExtrOcamlNatInt (nat as OCaml int; used for script bytes 0..255 and list length)

representation.height_epoch_subsidy_amounts: Coq Z → extracted inductive Z (not OCaml int)
representation.T_and_sigma: Coq Z, 256-bit class; never converted to OCaml int in the kernel
representation.script_bytes: Coq nat via ExtrOcamlNatInt → OCaml int (0..255)
representation.candidate_order: Coq list order; winner independent of scan order (txid tie-break)

overflow_policy: Kernel arithmetic stays on extracted Z. CLI decimal printer uses Z.div/modulo. ExtrOcamlNatInt is a trusted bound only for byte-sized nat.
